---
applyTo: "**"
textId: "INST-003"
---

When debugging and fixing tests, it is best to focus on resolving one error or
warning at a time.

However, to avoid rate-limiting issues with GitHub Copilot, it is acceptable to
bundle a small number of related fixes into a single interaction. Once the
fixes are applied, commit the changes and then repeat the process. This
approach of using micro-batches is permitted.

Always be mindful of opportunities to address multiple issues at once, but
proceed with caution to avoid introducing new problems.
